# Third-party: nerve-console-deep-health (wave-4 slot 315)

No new dependencies and no copied code. The deep route probe reuses the
nerve's own std-only HTTP client (`crates/openmind-nerve/src/util.rs`) and the
existing `serde_json`. `Cargo.lock` is unchanged.
